item.title: What’s next for Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro after election defeat?
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro's clandestine escape to the United States bewildered Brazil and triggered a frantic search for his whereabouts. The Supreme Court had ordered the son of jailed ex-leader Jair Bolsonaro to forfeit his passports after his electoral loss on Sunday, amid fears he would leave the country due to ongoing investigations against him. But the defeated right-wing presidential candidate failed to hand them in, choosing instead to flee to the US via Argentina and Ecuador. FRANCE 24's Tim Vickery reports from Rio de Janeiro. item.title: High-speed train crash kills at least 68 people in Spain
item.description: A high-speed train collision south of Madrid killed 68 people and injured scores more on Wednesday, with the toll likely to rise, authorities said, in one of Europe's deadliest such disasters this century. The second such accident to strike Spain this year will raise fresh questions about the country's rail safety, with the transport minister speaking of an "error" and "inexplicable circumstances" that led to the collision. item.description: Minutos de silencio en homenaje a las víctimas del accidente ferroviario del pasado 28 de octubre en Toledo, España, mientras continúan las labores de rescate y atención a los heridos. Por su parte y de cara a las campañas preelectorales, partidos de oposición exigen responsabilidades políticas. Informe de nuestra corresponsal, Marina Colorado. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: League Cup: Liverpool edges Chelsea in penalty shoot-out
item.description: Liverpool reached the League Cup quarter-finals after eliminating Chelsea on penalties (6-5), following a 1-1 draw. Wesley Fofana sealed the Blues’ exit by sending his spot-kick well over the bar. Another French defender at Chelsea, Maxence Lacroix, went off injured before half-time, a week before the France squad is announced. Fuente: France 24 - English.
